The '''Quellor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. A [[Battle of the Quellor system (Mandalorian Wars)|battle]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] was fought here in [[3962 BBY]].
